name: pam_time
detailed_description: Access control module that restricts login based on time-based rules from /etc/security/time.conf. Enables time-window restrictions for user access to specific systems. Supports complex time and day-of-week patterns.
notes:
Restricts login to specific times defined in /etc/security/time.conf
